title: Serino 2007 blind cane-user static near/far PPS
citation: Serino, A., Bassolino, M., Farne, A., & Ladavas, E. (2007). Extended multisensory space in blind cane users. Psychological Science, 18(7), 642-648.
notes: Manual PDF audit extracted the static near/far audio-tactile task: 150 ms white-noise bursts, near hand versus far cane/handle-tip source positions, weak electrical tactile targets, strong electrical tactile nontargets, auditory-only catch trials, and vocal response to weak tactile targets. Exact source noise, electrical pulse details, ITI, and numeric response window were not reported, so this profile is a known-parameter runnable contract rather than a full physical reproduction.

reference_parameters.reported_near_sound_position: close to the stimulated right hand
reference_parameters.reported_far_sound_position: on the floor approximately 125 cm from the hand at the cane or handle tip
reference_parameters.reported_tactile_site: upper side of the right index finger
reference_parameters.reported_response_rule: verbal response only to weak tactile targets; withhold response for strong tactile nontargets and auditory-only catches
reference_parameters.reported_trial_formula: 30 weak-target near + 30 weak-target far + 30 strong-nontarget near + 30 strong-nontarget far + 30 auditory-only catch trials = 150 trials per described task.
reference_parameters.profile_scope: The audiotactile task parameters are encoded. Cane versus handle and training-session context remain non-blocking experimental context until ordered intervention phases are needed.
implementation_gaps: exact white-noise source asset, seed, and spectral recipe
exact electrical tactile pulse duration, waveform, current, and electrode impedance calibration
exact ITI or jitter distribution and numeric response window
exact voice-key response capture threshold and latency correction

provenance.source: For-AI/research/literature/audiotactile-paper-metadata-audit/manual_reviews/serino_2007_blind_cane_users.json records a high-confidence manual PDF review of the main paper text and rendered pages.
Manual review records 150 ms white-noise bursts, 70 dB ear-level equalization, near hand sound simultaneous with touch, and far floor/cane-tip sound 5 ms before touch.

Manual review records Digitimer DS7A electrical stimulation of the upper right index finger, weak targets at about 90% perception, strong nontargets at about 100% perception, and verbal response only to weak tactile targets.
Manual review records 30 weak-target near, 30 weak-target far, 30 strong-nontarget near, 30 strong-nontarget far, and 30 sound-only catch trials per described task.
